purpose: Synthetic fixture evaluation, not production catalog or provider measurement.
split: 25 disjoint categories development, 15 holdout, eight scenarios each; deterministic split.

scoring.pass: Candidate evidence establishes all stated requirements.
scoring.fail: Evidence contradicts at least one requirement.
scoring.precision_at_5: Report PASS / displayed candidates with UNVERIFIED separately; never count unknown as correct.
scoring.recall_at_10: Only computable against fixture pool; never claim catalog or production recall.
scoring.zero_results: Only measure while exercising actual retrieval, not preselected pools.

rules: Freeze all four files and record hashes before modifying implementation.
Do not inspect holdout answers during development.
Fix implementation and record commit before opening holdout answers.
After holdout-driven changes use a fresh independent holdout.
Synthetic titles and prices are not real inventory or price evidence.
